p3c1.caption: §45 · The hermeneutic circuit stands open where wholeness is missing
p3c1.content: Inquiry not yet begun: fore-having/fore-sight/fore-conception lack primordiality until authenticity + wholeness come to light. Concentric broken rings, inner ring gapped widest at top-right where the missing wholeness would stand.

openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark (Fraunces italic): Vorhabe · Vorsicht · Vorgriff — via legal hooks

p3c1.paletteRole: ash-threshold (Act I): ink ground, lichen outer rings, mist inner ring; no ember
p3c1.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; carved divider treatment before the six-stage Division program (final para, P18); calm body
p3c1.title: The Result of the Preparatory Fundamental Analysis of Dasein and the Task of a Primordial, Existential Interpretation of this Being

p3c10.caption: §54 · Attestation: the seal Dasein itself bears
p3c10.content: Act III opens: authentic possibility needs attestation; the disputed yet familiar 'voice of conscience' is claimed as the seal. Split beams enter: caller/called not yet distinguished — the promise of a voice before sound.

openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: Bezeugung (attestation) — via legal hooks

p3c10.paletteRole: seal-mist: ink ground, mist seal, lichen erasures; ember withheld — a search, not a finding
p3c10.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; §§55-60 program list (final para, P9) as carved contents-within-chapter; calm body
p3c10.title: The Problem of the Attestation of an Authentic Existentiell Possibility

p3c11.caption: §55 · Silence breaks in from the margin
p3c11.content: Lost in idle talk Dasein fails to hear itself; the call comes as an unmediated silent jolt from afar to afar. Babble fills left two-thirds; the clean cut enters from the right edge — the margin interrupts the plate.

openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: Hören — 'vocal utterance is not essential to discourse' (P3) — via legal hooks

p3c11.paletteRole: noise-vs-cut: ink ground, lichen babble (busy but dim), mist cut; shortest conscience plate (4 paras)
p3c11.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; calm body; P3 pull-line treatment for the load-bearing sentence
p3c11.title: The Existential and Ontological Foundations of Conscience

p3c12.caption: §56 · What the call says, strictly speaking: nothing
p3c12.content: Conscience as call: summoned is the they-self, summoned-to is one's ownmost self — and the call says strictly nothing, speaking solely in the mode of silence (P7). Deliberate minimal plate: NICHTS carved large, flush-left, three broken arcs approaching but never touching.

openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: Ruf — via legal hooks; plate itself carries no rail column

p3c12.paletteRole: austerity: ink ground, mist word + arcs, nothing else; the silence IS the palette
p3c12.readingTreatment: calmest body: threshold first-para; P7 'mode of silence' pull-line; extra paragraph spacing; flush-left throughout (centering OVERRULED)
p3c12.title: The Character of Conscience as a Call

p3c13.caption: §57 · Not-at-home: the caller is Dasein itself
p3c13.content: The caller is not alien power or God but Dasein in its uncanniness — thrown, not-at-home — the call of care. Small tilted hut low in the plate (lowliness = thrownness) under the wide thin-wall arc; cuts rise from the ridge crack: from me, and yet over me.

openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: unheimlich — 'thin wall', 'cold assurance' — via legal hooks

p3c13.paletteRole: cold assurance: ink ground, mist house + arc + rising cuts, lichen ridge; no warmth permitted
p3c13.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; P14 care-formula (caller/summoned/called) as carved three-line stanza; calm body
p3c13.title: Conscience as the Call of Care

p3c14.caption: §58 · Thrown projection never gets back behind its thrownness
p3c14.content: Beneath debt/owing/moral-fault lies primordial guilt: being-the-ground of a nullity (P12-13) — 'nullity' first defined here (P12). Abyss of descending rings to unmarked black; the plumb-line frays and dissolves before reaching bottom. Longest cohort chapter (33 paras): plate earns its scale.

openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: Schuld — guilt enters the margin for the first time — via legal hooks

p3c14.paletteRole: guilt register in book ink: ink ground, mist plumb-line, lichen/bark abyss rings (oxide→book-ink per merge); widest threshold
p3c14.readingTreatment: threshold first-para (+4rem wide); sub-divider treatments at vulgar survey (P6-10), formal definition (P12-13), wanting-to-have-a-conscience turn (P28-33); 'being-the-ground of a nullity' pull-line
p3c14.title: Understanding the Summons and Guilt

p3c15.caption: §59 · The ledger cracks where it meets the uncounted
p3c15.content: Four objections answered (P5-8): bad conscience points forward by calling back; 'good' conscience is Pharisaism; the call gives no maxims but one's ownmost possibility. Only split plate: ruled ledger (grid, scales glyph) cracking and sloughing where it meets the unruled abyss-rings.

openerComposition.beam: split: EM-ledger vs DM-abyss (excavated vs unexcavated, p3c15-only)
openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: Abrechnung ('balancing accounts', the vulgar idiom — indicted by placement) — via legal hooks

p3c15.paletteRole: most saturated conscience plate: lichen grid + mist cracks (ledger half) vs ink + lichen abyss (existential half); vulgar gaudiness argued-against by the phenomenon
p3c15.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; four objections (P5-8) as carved enumeration (prose-enumerated, numbering legitimate); 'life is a business' voiced italic
p3c15.title: The Existential Interpretation of Conscience and the Vulgar Interpretation of Conscience

p3c16.caption: §60 · Resoluteness: the ring completed by occupation, not closure
p3c16.content: Cohort climax: resoluteness — reticent self-projection on ownmost guilt, ready for anxiety — discloses Situation (P14); one can 'become the conscience of others'. The ring returns; a standing figure occupies the gap; light breaks HORIZONTALLY (only horizontal plate: arrival, rest); rejoined beam.

openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: Entschlossenheit — via legal hooks

p3c16.paletteRole: clearing: shaft/mist bands on ink (NO new ground token); mist ring; ember/oxide fully absent — guilt taken over, not painted
p3c16.readingTreatment: threshold first-para (+4rem wide); anxiety/understanding/reticence triad (P3-6) as carved stanza; P14 Situation pull-line; cohort-closing divider (completed-by-occupation ring glyph)
p3c16.title: The Existential Structure of the Authentic Potentiality-of-Being Attested to in Conscience

p3c2.caption: §46 · The gap, not the ring, is the subject
p3c2.content: Care's ahead-of-itself leaves something always outstanding — the whole seems ungraspable — yet the impossibility may be merely formal ('end'/'death' undefined). Near-circle gapped by a quarter arc; the missing quarter scatters as chips drifting ahead. Sparest plate (shortest chapter, 6 paras).

openerComposition.gapPlacement: widest-open: quarter-arc gap upper-right, negative space centered right, ring pushed left
openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark (Fraunces italic): Ausstand — via legal hooks

p3c2.paletteRole: coldest plate: ink ground, lichen ring, mist chips; impossibility statement
p3c2.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; §§47-53 program list (final para, P6) as carved contents-within-chapter; calm body
p3c2.title: The Seeming Impossibility of Ontologically Grasping and Determining Dasein as a Whole

p3c3.caption: §47 · No one can take another's dying away
p3c3.content: Substitute-theme refuted: the dying of others is loss for those remaining ('at best always just nearby'), dying is in each instance mineness. Funeral frieze in the plate's lower third, vast black above; two mourners in different line weights flank the empty center — the vacancy is the subject. Umschlag 'sudden transition' (P3) as the hard gouge-line.

openerComposition.gapPlacement: path narrows: frieze low, void above
openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: dabei ('merely nearby') at the void's edge — via legal hooks

p3c3.paletteRole: death enters: ink ground, mist figures, lichen void-hatching, ember floor (first of p3c3-p3c9)
p3c3.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; Verenden/Ableben/Sterben triad rail note where defined; calm body
p3c3.title: The Possibility of Experiencing the Death of Others and the Possibility of Grasping Dasein as a Whole

p3c4.caption: §48 · Toward the end, not at an end
p3c4.content: Debt-sums, the moon's last quarter, ripening fruit each tested and rejected as models for Dasein's not-yet; Dasein is always already its end. Three vertical panels struck by ONE continuous diagonal cut — one rejection gesture; foot-line maxim 'old enough to die right away' carved in the plate.

openerComposition.gapPlacement: path narrows: panels fill, cut aligns
openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: zum Ende ('being toward the end, not being-at-an-end') — via legal hooks

p3c4.paletteRole: ink ground, lichen struck panels, mist cut + maxim foot-line, ember floor
p3c4.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; three theses (P5-7) as carved propositions (prose-enumerated, numbering legitimate); calm body
p3c4.title: What is Outstanding, End, and Wholeness

p3c5.caption: §49 · The path threads the exclusions untouched
p3c5.content: Methodical boundary (P4-5 'purely this-worldly'): biology/psychology/theodicy/theology/metaphysics set aside; Sterben reserved from Verenden/Ableben. Five dim bars; the single unbroken mist line weaves between them — restraint is the argument.

openerComposition.gapPlacement: path narrows: bars span, line weaves
openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: Sterben (what the chapter positively reserves) — via legal hooks

p3c5.paletteRole: ink ground, dimmed bars (the excluded disciplines), mist path, ember floor
p3c5.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; five excluded disciplines as quiet rail index; calm body
p3c5.title: How the Existential Analysis of Death Differs from Other Possible Interpretations of this Phenomenon

p3c6.caption: §50 · Not the thunderstorm: eminent imminence
p3c6.content: Death is not an imminent event like the thunderstorm (P3) but the ownmost/nonrelational/insuperable possibility (P5-9), disclosed in anxiety. Storm band low with lightning over a roofline; above it three mist arcs triangulate a point over the reader's head.

openerComposition.gapPlacement: path narrows: storm low, arcs triangulate above
openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: Bevorstand (imminence aimed at the reader) — via legal hooks

p3c6.paletteRole: anxiety's plate: ink ground, lichen storm (the misleading example stays dim), mist arcs, ember floor
p3c6.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; 'ownmost, nonrelational, insuperable possibility' as pull-line at first occurrence; calm body
p3c6.title: A Preliminary Sketch of the Existential and Ontological Structure of Death

p3c7.caption: §51 · One dies — but for now, one is not affected
p3c7.content: Everyday evasion: the they's idle talk ('one dies', P4/P7) tempts/tranquilizes/estranges, leveling my ownmost possibility into a public 'case'. Only plate with NO void — claustrophobic by design: flat rows of identical glyphs, one bone hollow ('no one'), the ribbon flattened into a rule.

openerComposition.gapPlacement: path closed: crowd fills edge to edge, no void
openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: man stirbt — intrudes from the right margin, breaking the rows — via legal hooks

p3c7.paletteRole: oppressive flatness: ink ground, lichen crowd (leveled-down), single mist hollow + rule, ember floor
p3c7.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; temptation/tranquilization/estrangement triad rail note; voiced 'one dies' phrases in italic serif
p3c7.title: Being-toward-Death and the Everydayness of Dasein

p3c8.caption: §52 · Certain — and as such indefinite
p3c8.content: Certainty/indefiniteness recovered from evasion: the ownmost, nonrelational, certain-and-indefinite, insuperable possibility — 'possible at any moment'. Crisp mist ring (CERTAIN) + stipple-dissolving ring (INDEFINITE) share one gap; the orbiting point is the uncalculable 'when'. Full formula at P14.

openerComposition.gapPlacement: path at full formula: shared gap upper-right
openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: gewiss–unbestimmt — via legal hooks

p3c8.paletteRole: two line-weights argue: ink ground, mist crisp ring, lichen dissolving ring, ember floor
p3c8.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; P14 full-formula paragraph with left-cut rule + wider measure (the Division's thesis sentence); calm body
p3c8.title: Everyday Being-toward-Death and the Complete Existential Concept of Death

p3c9.caption: §53 · Anticipation: holding the possibility open as possibility
p3c9.content: PHASE-B EXEMPLAR. Authentic being-toward-death as Vorlaufen (P7: anticipation vs Erwarten expecting, P4-7): neither actualizing death nor waiting for it — 'passionate anxious freedom toward death' — until attested (P20-21 bridge into Act III). Lone figure leans into the headwind walking right into the SINGLE vertical beam (no trunks); collapsed boxes of 'expecting' pile behind; ember cleft = freedom's first warmth.

openerComposition.gapPlacement: climax: figure strides into the beam
openerComposition.railNote: rail landmark: Vorlaufen vs Erwarten (P4-7) — via legal hooks

p3c9.paletteRole: climax: ink ground, mist figure + wind-lines, ember cleft (rationed peak), lichen collapsed boxes; ember floor brightest
p3c9.readingTreatment: threshold first-para; Vorlaufen/Erwarten rail glosses (P4-7); P20-21 attestation bridge as carved forward-link; calm body
p3c9.title: Existential Project of an Authentic Being-toward-Death
